description: Generic Sony PlayStation game profile (Western convention). X is confirm (face_south), Circle is cancel (face_east), Square is special (face_west), Triangle is item (face_north). Japanese PSX titles invert confirm/cancel; ship a region-specific profile when shipping a Japanese title.

confirm.hint: Press X (Cross). Advance dialog, confirm menu choice, jump in platformers. Western convention; Japanese games may invert this.

cancel.hint: Press Circle. Cancel menu, run away in JRPGs, secondary attack.

special.hint: Press Square. Game-specific: secondary attack, sub-weapon, item use.

use_item.hint: Press Triangle. Game-specific: inventory hotkey, special action, vehicle exit.

menu.hint: Press Start. Open the pause / inventory menu, start the game from the title screen.

back.hint: Press Select. Game-specific: map / secondary menu / character cycle.

nav_up.hint: Move up. Most PSX games also accept the left analog stick for this — the agent only emits d-pad in v1.

nav_down.hint: Move down. D-pad only in v1; analog stick not yet wired.

nav_left.hint: Move left. D-pad only in v1.

nav_right.hint: Move right. D-pad only in v1.

notes: All four shoulders/triggers and both stick clicks are passthrough. PSX action games rely on them heavily (camera, weapon cycle, defense); per-game profiles should bind the most-used ones to specific universal actions. Analog sticks are not represented — they need an analog wire channel that v1 doesn't have.
